personalInfo.name: Karam Matar
personalInfo.title: Software Engineer
personalInfo.bio: Software engineer building backend and full-stack applications with Python, TypeScript and SQL. My work spans satellite-imagery review at Kravi Analytics, an employee survey platform at Softhouse, and dependency-security tooling for Trafikverket.
personalInfo.availableText: Open to full-time roles · Skåne preferred · Open to international relocation

paragraphs: I enjoy taking a practical problem through to working software. At Kravi Analytics, I built the initial version of a Python platform for reviewing satellite imagery, integrating TIFF files from S3. It is now used across the company, and I maintain and extend it with a growing focus on backend development. At Softhouse, I contributed full-stack features, security fixes and automated testing in an 11-person team while coordinating customer communication and demonstrations.

I hold a B.Sc. in Software Engineering from BTH and spent an exchange semester at Newcastle University. My systems background includes building a compiler and virtual machine in C++ and mentoring first-year C++ students. For my bachelor's thesis with Iquest AB, I co-developed an autonomous multi-agent bug-fix workflow that creates pull requests for mandatory human review.

I'm based in Örkelljunga and looking for backend or full-stack engineering roles, preferably in Skåne, especially Malmö, and open to international relocation. Outside web development, I enjoy building games in Unity/C# and C++/SFML and studying algorithms through competitive programming.

description: Independently built the initial Python/FastAPI platform for reviewing satellite vessel detections, now used company-wide; maintained and extended it as requirements evolved.
Integrated S3-hosted TIFF imagery, geospatial review batches and MaskNet’s existing annotation workflow, with mask annotations stored in PostgreSQL.
Fixed database connection-pool exhaustion causing HTTP 500 errors during image preloading.
Wrote automated tests and independently set up GitHub Actions CI, branch protections, Docker deployment and a server firewall.
Built full-stack TeamTemp survey features in an 11-person team, including configurable scale questions and role handling. Fixed tester-reported vulnerabilities through server-side validation.
Wrote Cypress end-to-end tests and assisted with Bitbucket CI/CD; the team's testing also included unit and integration tests.
Led customer communication and demos; as Scrum Master for one sprint, split features and requirements into smaller, categorized tasks.
Supported code reviews and merge-conflict resolution; the team's delivery was formally accepted as exceeding customer expectations.

experiences.location: Remote via Blekinge Institute of Technology, Sweden
description: Contributed to a shared PowerShell-to-JavaScript refactor for an Azure DevOps task that scans dependencies for vulnerabilities.
Helped develop database functionality and a Windows process deleting entries older than 90 days; assisted with Azure DevOps packaging and CI/CD.
Kept team members and the Head of Department updated on progress.
Supported first-year C++ students with debugging, pointers, memory management and OOP through occasional mini-lectures, demonstrations and one-to-one guidance.
Coordinated support sessions with other teaching assistants and independently offered additional one-to-one help outside scheduled sessions.

projects.title: TeamTemp — Softhouse
projects.description: Employee survey platform developed in an 11-person team. My contributions included configurable scale questions, branch/user role handling, server-side validation fixes, automated testing, CI/CD assistance and customer demonstrations.
projects.longDescription: An employee survey and engagement platform delivered by an 11-person team at Softhouse. I contributed configurable scale questions, branch/user role handling, application-security measures and Cypress end-to-end tests, and assisted with Bitbucket CI/CD setup and test integration. The team's testing included unit, integration and end-to-end tests for features and changes. As Scrum Master for one sprint, I broke down features and requirements into smaller, categorized tasks for the team. I also coordinated customer communication and demonstrations, and used server-side validation to fix additional vulnerabilities reported by Softhouse developers testing the platform. The team delivery was formally accepted as exceeding customer expectations.

projects.title: Compiler from Scratch
projects.description: End-to-end compiler built from scratch in C++ — lexer, parser, semantic analysis, CFG-based IR, TAC generation, and a custom virtual machine — all without external parser generators.
projects.longDescription: Built an end-to-end compiler in C++ from scratch, implementing lexical analysis, recursive-descent parsing, semantic analysis, control-flow graph based intermediate representation, three-address code generation, and a custom virtual machine for execution — all without external parser generators or compiler toolkits.

projects.title: ShowcaseSERL
projects.description: Next.js/TypeScript website for BTH's Software Engineering Research Lab, with searchable project listings, detail views and an automated kiosk display mode.
projects.longDescription: A JSON-backed Next.js application showcasing student and researcher projects for BTH's Software Engineering Research Lab. Features searchable and filterable listings, project detail views, responsive layouts and a configurable kiosk mode for public displays.

projects.title: VulnerabilityChecker 2.0
projects.description: Dependency-security tooling developed in a six-person team for Trafikverket. Contributed to PowerShell-to-JavaScript refactoring, database functionality and Windows-based cleanup of entries older than 90 days.
projects.longDescription: A six-person project to modernize dependency-security tooling for Trafikverket, including an Azure DevOps task for vulnerability scanning and JSON SBOM generation. My contributions focused on the shared PowerShell-to-JavaScript refactor, database work and a Windows-based process to automate removal of entries older than 90 days. I also assisted team members with task packaging and CI/CD integration during collaborative development sessions, and kept team members and the Head of Department informed of project developments.

projects.title: ACID Bot — Bachelor Thesis
projects.description: Co-developed an autonomous multi-agent workflow that retrieves bug-fix tasks from ClickUp, implements and tests changes, and creates pull requests for mandatory human review. Bachelor's thesis with Iquest AB.
projects.longDescription: A collaborative B.Sc. thesis with Iquest AB exploring an autonomous multi-agent bug-fix workflow from task intake to pull-request creation. Human review and approval are mandatory before merging or deployment. The source code belongs to Iquest AB; the linked thesis is academic documentation.

projects.title: Death Marching Souls
projects.description: Unity/C# action-platformer with movement and combat, enemy and boss encounters, collectible power-ups, health and XP-based progression, and in-game UI.
projects.longDescription: A 3D action-platformer built in Unity/C#, featuring character movement, combat, modular enemy behavior, boss encounters, collectible power-ups, health management, experience-based leveling and UI systems.

projects.title: Space Invaders
projects.description: Co-developed a C++/SFML arcade shooter with a game loop, collision handling, enemy formations, menus, audio and persistent scoring.
projects.longDescription: A collaborative BTH coursework project with Abduvohid Ilhomov. Built a Space Invaders-inspired arcade shooter using C++ and SFML, with player input, enemy formations, collision handling, health/lives, menus, audio and persistent scores.

projects.title: GyaGame
projects.description: 2D semi-open-world shooter game in Java using a provided graphics library, featuring game logic, entity management, collision systems, and player interaction.
projects.longDescription: A Java game project featuring core gameplay systems such as movement, shooting, and game logic, built using a provided graphics library.
